class CompactLayerNormBias(nn.Module):
    """LayerNorm with two downstream-linear-absorbed bias coordinates fixed."""

    def __init__(self, layer_norm: nn.LayerNorm):
        super().__init__()

        self.bias = nn.Parameter(layer_norm.bias[:-2].detach().clone())
